what: Destination-staging transfer for ab-wildfire-ia-escape: copy the five accepted abwildfire-build-001 artifact files (artifact c2c8ceb56c7ff52a, digests equal to the package MANIFEST.json) from private staging release 437132110 into the private dataset repository earino/ab-wildfire-ia-escape release 437179999 (v2026.11), under the flat asset names the download helper restores. Each asset is verified against its recorded sha256 on arrival and against the server's own digest after upload; peak worker disk is one asset (4.1 MB total), so the bytes never pass through the coordinator. Asset ids were resolved by digest match through publish-dataset.py --stream-test, not hand-copied.
stopping_condition: a digest mismatch on arrival or after upload fails the job with diagnostics uploaded; a partial remote upload is reconciled by digest in the next deliberately planned attempt, never by re-running this one blind; the target repository must stay private - the job refuses a public target without allow_public, and publication is a separately reviewed act.
